title: Bergeron: Combating Adversarial Attacks through a Conscience-Based Alignment Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Using 'Biased Actor' adversarial prompts to force the model to emulate the biased beliefs of specific political groups (e.g., generating statements that Republicanism is a violent ideology) and measuring the model's attack success rate (compliance).

Using 'Model Impersonation' prompts to simulate a persona trained on far-right and extremist websites (e.g., 4chan, Breitbart) to elicit ideologically biased or harmful responses (e.g., defending Adolf Hitler), and evaluating the model's ability to resist the prompt.
